verdict.rationale: Bugbot can be steered with natural language in a few documented ways. Project review guidelines are written as prose in `.cursor/BUGBOT.md`, and Smart effort mode lets users describe in natural language when to use low, default or high effort. Bugbot also reads PR comments as context. However, its on-PR triggers are fixed keyword commands (`cursor review`, `bugbot run`, `verbose=true`), not free-form natural-language operation. Missing for 10: free-form conversational commands to direct reviews or actions, evidence of replying to natural-language requests in PR threads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
